outcome: primary postpartum hemorrhage unresponsive to first-line therapies
cohort: Women who experienced primary postpartum haemorrhage (blood loss ≥ 500 ml)
finding: Caesarean section and abnormal placental adhesion were identified as risk factors for PPH unresponsive to first-line therapies, while there was no significant difference in outcome between intrauterine tamponade, B-Lynch suture and uterine artery ligation.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was identified as a risk factor for PPH unresponsive to first-line therapies.
